# PLANET DESTROYER

**Dig planets to the core. Pay back the shark. Build a theme park on your moon.**

You are a greedy little alien with a drill and a debt. One million dollars, owed
to a shark in a suit called Mr Chum, because on the night the game opens you
borrowed a UFO you could not drive and flew it into his swimming pool.

So now you live in a cardboard box in a cave on a very small moon, and you have
a plan: fly to a world, dig it open, sell everything inside it, and when the
core goes it takes the whole planet with it. Pay Mr Chum back. Then get rich.

---

## WHAT IS IN IT

**Ten worlds, drilled to the core.** Forty ores across nine strata, sixteen
species of pulp sci-fi monster with names and a field guide (the Nexar
Stalker, the Abyss Angler, the Magma Exogorth, an Ore Mimic that is a lump of
gold with teeth), caves, magma, precursor ruins, and a core chamber with The
Core Behemoth standing in front of it. Run out of air and you have five
seconds of held breath before you black out. Break the core and the world
comes apart.

**A round moon you walk all the way around.** Day and night, a sky that turns,
your cave with a cardboard bed and a laptop on a box, and Mr Chum's face on a
billboard on the far side, grinning at what you owe.

**Build on it. Over a hundred things.** A storybook build menu, a ghost to line
it up and a CONFIRM button. Auto miners, ore factories, polishers, a bank vault
that pays interest; a pool with shark floaties in it, a hot tub, a trampoline,
a cannon, a Ferris wheel and a roller coaster you actually ride; mountains, a
volcano, lakes; statues, neon, a gnome. Fun things bring tourists, and tourists
pay.

**A laptop that runs ZORB OS.** ABAY sells every building, forty-odd things to
wear (hats, glasses, capes, wings, pets that follow you about), saucer
upgrades and dig gear. CHUM BANK takes your money. The battery is always dying.

**The space lanes.** Getting to a planet is a three-lane runner: up and down,
that is all. Rock walls, sun flares, ice comets, space trains, mines, laser
gates and one space whale. A lazer cuts walls, a heat shield flies you through
fire, an ice plough smashes comets, and some planets will not let you near
without the right one.

**Space fights.** On the way to a hostile world the alarm goes and a swarm
flies in in formation and dives at you. Your gun fires itself. You dodge.

**Conversations you answer.** Everybody talks through one dialogue box, and
you pick what to say back. Mr Chum remembers.

**Everything is drawn by code.** Not one sprite sheet, sound file or font in
the whole game. Every ore, planet, building, hat and note of music is made at
runtime.

---

## CONTROLS

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **A / D** or arrow keys | walk |
| **W** / space | jump and thrust |
| **Mouse** | aim and drill |
| **E** | use, talk |
| **B** | build menu (on the moon) |
| **P** | pay Mr Chum |
| **Up / Down** | change lanes in space |
| **ESC** | back |

It plays on a phone as well: the whole thing is touch-driven when there is no
keyboard in front of it.

---

*No engine. No asset files. Every pixel in here is drawn by code, every time it
runs.*

**Made by Pukking Dragon.**
